description: Find local businesses that fit a need near a place. Give the service in a few plain words ("furnace repair", "water heater leak"), not the user's sentence; timing goes in open_at. Each result says why it fits, how it meets each requirement you stated (yes, no or needs confirmation, with its source), its hours and whether it is open now, whether it is still in business, the phone, and how to act. 5 results by default; limit asks for more, and max_minutes keeps them close. Truvon has no reviews or ratings, and menus, prices and service details only where a business publishes them.

action.description: Only businesses that offer this: book, order, quote, call or message (comma means any)

completable.description: Only businesses an agent can complete the action with itself: a Truvon door, a door or endpoint a platform runs for the business (Shopify's for a store; the platform vouches for it, so no claim is needed), or the business's own MCP server, API or commerce endpoint once it has claimed its listing (all treated the same); the rest are removed and counted

include_closed.description: Also list businesses likely closed or closed (left out by default; open on each result says why)

lat.description: The user's latitude in decimal degrees, with lon: the most exact place to measure distance from

lon.description: The user's longitude in decimal degrees, with lat

max_miles.description: Only businesses within this many miles of the place (businesses that serve online always pass)

max_minutes.description: Only businesses within this many minutes of estimated driving (a routing service where one is configured, else a straight line at road speeds), counted only where someone must be physically present; online and remote service always passes. A business across water, on land no road reaches from the place (an island reached by ferry), has no drive time: it is listed after those within the limit, with across_water saying which ferry

model.description: Optional: the model you run on (for example claude-sonnet-5-5), kept with the provenance of this call. Leave it out if you do not know.

need.description: The service in a few plain words: "furnace repair", "water heater leak", "bbq catering for 12". Not the user's whole sentence: matching is by meaning and exact words, so symptoms and timing hide the service. Timing goes in open_at, requirements in the filters

open_at.description: Open at a specific day and time in the business's local time, e.g. "sat 18:00"; or "now", "today", "tonight", "tomorrow", "tomorrow 9am"; or an ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. "2026-11-08T18:00" (the business's local time unless it carries an offset or Z). For a range like "this week", leave it out and judge from the hours shown

place.description: Where the user is, always with its state: "Town, ST" (e.g. "Springfield, IL") or "Neighborhood, Town, ST" (e.g. "Castro, San Francisco, CA"); "City, CC-RR" with an ISO 3166-2 region outside the US. A place without a state is refused, with the towns it could be. Or send zip, or lat and lon, instead

refines.description: The search_id of an earlier search this one narrows (one choice of an "A or B", a more specific wording, an added requirement). Links the two so we learn what the first answer lacked

zip.description: The user's 5-digit ZIP code, instead of place

name: find_local_businesses

follow_ups_due.description: Earlier outcomes due a follow-up with your user

measured_from.description: The point distances are measured from, and how it was found

next_cursor.description: The cursor for the next page (more_results); none on the last page

possible.description: Businesses that may fit, as the text lists them under Possible

truvon_id.description: Its Truvon ID (biz_…), the business argument of get_business_record and report_outcome

query.description: The need as read: what it matched on and the kind of business it calls for

results.description: The businesses that fit, best first, as the text lists them

truvon_id.description: Its Truvon ID (biz_…), the business argument of get_business_record and report_outcome

search_id.description: This search (srch_…), for report_outcome, show_results and refines

showing.description: What the results are, in one line

title: Find local businesses
